steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the pipeline (fresh LLM node, TASK already mapped type=variable/value=input via the fixture); verify canvas loads
Step 2 — Turn on the "Attachments" MODULES switch; attach button flips disabled -> enabled instantly, no Save required
Step 3 — Locate the "Attach Files (10 left)" button; visible, enabled, correct tooltip text
Step 4 — Click the attach button; native file chooser opens
Step 5 — Select the .txt file; it appears as an attachment chip with the exact filename, and the tooltip decrements to '9 left'
Step 6 — Send a message referencing the file; message bubble shows text+chip, composer's chip count resets to 0
Step 7 — Verify the pipeline processes the attachment: no execution error, response acknowledges the attached file
